durability_boundary: Durable across process restart on the single authoritative host. NOT distributed, multi-node or HA durable; a second authority host pointed at the same stores fails closed (SplitBrainAuthorityError).

claims.allowed_language: Owner-scoped persistent creative identities can be reused across projects with version pinning.
limitations: Durable authority is per-host SQLite (topology=single_host_durable), not distributed/HA.
Owner scope is a single owner id string; org/team sharing is not implemented.
Cross-project reuse is same-owner only; explicit share grants are not implemented.
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT a globally shared character network; NOT cross-tenant sharing. 'Global' means one owner's persistent identity, private by default.

claims.allowed_language: HEVI validates structured canon and continuity before production and can block hard contradictions.
limitations: Hard-constraint contradiction detection is an explicit negation-marker match, not full NLU entailment.
Unrecorded location/prop yields WARN (unrecorded state), not a proven contradiction.
Legacy writing-room paths (narrative bible/tongjian sim) remain project-local creative inputs, not ledger truth.
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT 'AI guarantees narrative consistency'; it enforces structured, provenance-tracked facts.

claims.allowed_language: HEVI can automatically recover selected deterministic failures and requires confirmation before paid or creative-changing repairs.
limitations: Detection seams are wired at task/paid-regen failure paths; adapter-internal retries remain transport primitives surfacing at the task seam.
Repair execution delegates to the existing runtime/planners (single orchestrator); the incident store records policy/verification, not provider execution.
Currency verification recompute uses the task manifest; it does not re-probe remote provider state.
Incident durability is per-host (single_host_durable), not distributed.
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT 'HEVI automatically fixes every production failure' and NOT a second orchestrator/autonomous agent.

claims.allowed_language: Authenticated, owner-scoped authorities: identity, continuity, incident and creative memory are private to the server-derived owner; cross-owner reads and writes are refused.
limitations: Runtime/test-level isolation (test client + threaded stores), not an external third-party pentest.
Legacy incidents created before D4 owner-scoping are quarantined (invisible to owner-scoped callers), not back-filled.
Infrastructure-level hardening and compliance certification are out of scope.
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT SOC2/ISO certification and NOT hardened infrastructure isolation; it is application-level tenant isolation.

claims.allowed_language: Owner-scoped creative memory API exists and is consumed in planning composition.
limitations: Backend/API only; no dedicated Studio surface.
No net-new memory capability in D4/D5 (no feature expansion).
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT a new memory engine; not claimed as a full personalization product surface.

claims.allowed_language: Control plane is ready (adapters, policy, cost/privacy routing, hardware detection).
limitations: No local generation artifact produced on this host.

claims.allowed_language: A fail-closed lip-sync runtime qualification probe exists.
limitations: GPU unavailable, ComfyUI unavailable, EchoMimic unavailable; D2A_REOPEN_ALLOWED=false.
Talking-head-without-lip-sync is explicitly NOT counted as lip-sync.
claims.non_claimable_boundary: NOT claimable until the probe returns GPU_AVAILABLE/COMFYUI_REACHABLE/ECHOMIMIC/MODEL/REAL_PROBE/ARTIFACT_VALID all true.

prohibited_overclaims: HEVI automatically fixes every production failure
